'''Pulsar''', designated '''CT-9521''', was a [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|clone trooper sergeant]] who served in [[Tango Company/Legends|Tango Company]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
Pulsar, along with the rest of Tango Company, served on [[Geonosis]]. He was afterward sent on a medical supply run to [[Ord Cestus/Legends|Ord Cestus]]. While aboard a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] supply ship that was being transported back to Republic [[Realspace/Legends|space]] by [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Jedi Commanders]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] and [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]], he and the rest of the crew were infected by [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] [[Brain worm/Legends|brain worms]]. Pulsar, along with most of the crew, was cured when Ahsoka ruptured the cooling tanks of the [[TB-73/Legends|TB-73]] and killed the cold-sensitive worms.

==Equipment==
Pulsar carried a [[DC-15S/Legends|DC-15S]] carbine, and was featured wearing a backpack. He wore Phase I Armor with blue markings and bore a striped sigil on his armored shoulder plates that resembled a stylized tiger face.
